highlights: Update your joined servers to this version too, so that the CRM, Add account with code and agent backdrops work there.
Play an animated backdrop behind the whole window, or ask an agent to make one for you.
Try the experimental CRM in Server settings > Experimental, with a Stripe import and agent proposals that you approve.
Answer an agent in the agent dock chat without the main window.
A chat that loses its saved session recovers by itself, and more agents move to their backup model at a usage limit.
